method: Separate read-only postconstruction predicates over exact current source and completed authored records, by the director; not an independent human or separate agent and not numerical replay substituted for semantic completion.

perfect-spell.minimalCorrection: NEW PS222-FUNDED (Perfect Spell only): distinguish waived activation price from protected conversion principal. Perfect ignores the embedded base RP, discountable casting extras, components and casting time. A source-defined RP amount that is expressly non-discountable and whose actual expenditure directly funds the output remains an actual payment at the root commitment. For Harmonic Bulwark only the chosen X (integer 0..actual PB) is this protected principal: base paid=0, base waived=5, X paid=X, creditedRP=X, offer=5X. Root26 and all root/leaf surcharges supply zero leaf credit. X=0 has zero credit and is rejected before any root Action/RP is spent. Choose X, recipient and geometry before commitment; require available root quote plus X, commit both once, then counter/arbitrate. Countering or losing to an equal/stronger buffer refunds neither. X is not another cast, Action, root strain event or recovery trigger. Self is a legal willing recipient within both root120ft and Bulwark60ft; all ordinary source eligibility remains. No nominal credit, completed-buffer copy, Mana Shield alias or globally changed Bulwark interface is authorized.
perfect-spell.historicalNoCommitCase: RANK9CASTINGCOST5129-PERFECT-SPELL-B/funded-bulwark remains byte-exact historical evidence of the superseded full-X-waiver policy; not an active unresolved blocker.

unholy-ascendance.missing: A source-grounded recipient lifecycle for the newly authored same-identity Undead caster form, including ordinary zero HP versus qualifying Null zero HP, legal healing/type checks, actual death and ending/suppression over an existing form. Current Null explicitly enumerates ordinary living recipients, named companion/minion/projection/Construct lifecycles and actual Undying Spellform. It does not define this new caster Undead overlay.
requiredWitnesses: Explicitly establish the caster-form living/nonliving/type/recipientLifecycle contract without borrowing Wizard minion or Mage Lich destruction rules; identify the source permission for that bridge.

Show actual normal lethal/zero damage and qualifying same-dealer Null root histories, pre-event recipient snapshot, defenses/tempHP, HP/Wounds/death state, counters/recovery markers, no would-die trigger when Null skips death, and later independent non-damage source ending.

Show legally acquired living-only versus applicable Undead healing sources, eligibility recheck while operative/suppressed/reverted, actual paid/blocked/successful transitions and retained HP/Wounds/gear.

Show an already-operative real other form, suppression/resumption, original deadline, actual death/expiry and exact original body/equipment custody restoration; no refresh, new corpse, immortality or Hunt finality inference.
unholy-ascendance.whyWholeSpellGate: The proposed form explicitly changes operative type to Undead. Its own ordinary damage, healing and zero-HP behavior must be resolved before the complete procedure can be accepted; this is not merely an optional outside campaign actor. The missing external Hunt facts remain a separate conditional qualification, not a demand to close cosmology.
anchors: sources_current/DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/TRANSFORMATION_SPELL_PLAYTEST.md (four selected transformation profiles only; not global Undead permission)
